summary: Apartment car park ringed by dwellings, some within 5 m.
reasons: Houses 6 m away on west side

best_section.where: north edge of the car park, behind the northern apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by apartment blocks and houses; windows overlook every side.

drivers.convention: Appears to be resident parking for the flats; no campers seen.

sun_shade: Open gravel with trees on north and east sides giving partial shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is private or signed
